CREATIVE ARTS — TERMLY EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Brown, pink, and gold
   B. Red, blue, and yellow
   C. Green, orange, and purple
   D. Black, white, and grey

2. Best practice when working on Rhythm and Pattern Making: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Rhythm and Pattern Making.
   B. Practise Rhythm and Pattern Making with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm and Pattern Making.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm and Pattern Making.

3. Best practice when working on Painting and Collage: (1 mark)

   D. Disrupt classmates during Painting and Collage.

4. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)

   D. Refuse all feedback on Melody.

   B. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre.

   D. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery.

7. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Athletics.
   B. Damage equipment used for Athletics.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Athletics.
   D. Practise Athletics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles.

   D. Refuse all feedback on String Musical Instruments and Drawing.

12. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The speed of the music
   B. Only the costume
   C. The ticket price
   D. Only the volume

13. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   B. Replace drinking water
   C. Guarantee a trophy
   D. Remove the need for rules

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Analysis of Creative Arts works 15 Total Number of Lessons 180 NOTE: The suggest and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Analysis of Creative Arts works and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain String Musical Instruments and Drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
